thread:
Rachel: Heads-up — opened a docs PR to add long-sequence behavior notes for a few catalog entries (Llama2 variants + quantized builds). PR: https://internal/repo/pull/4520. Need a quick sanity check on the max_context numbers and a tiny SDK snippet.

Kai: Quick skim looks reasonable. One thing: for q8 variants we should show both 'supported' vs 'recommended' context sizes (supported = what runtime can accept, recommended = what keeps latency sane).

Ben: Agreed. Also we should include an SDK example that clarifies `max_sequence_length` vs `max_tokens` in the request. Proposal: 
```python
from redwood import Client
cli = Client()
resp = cli.generate(
    model='llama2-13b-q8',
    input='Summarize...',
    max_sequence_length=8192,  # model context cap
    max_tokens=1024            # output length cap
)
print(resp.text)
```
I can add that under /docs/sdk/snippets/sequence.md if that's the agreed format.

Rachel: Nice — can you also add a short comment about tokenizer truncation (some tokenizers truncate differently at internal boundaries)? That caused confusion in the original ticket. :thinking_face:

Harper: Uploaded the perf CSV for extended contexts: https://internal/bench/llama2-longseq.csv — TL;DR: q8 shows ~22% throughput drop at 32k vs 8k and p95 latency increases ~40%. Pasting the key rows: 
```csv
model,seq,tokens_per_sec,p95_ms
llama2-13b-q8,8192,1200,260
llama2-13b-q8,32768,940,364
llama2-13b,32768,1100,320
```
Add these numbers to the catalog note so users understand cost/latency tradeoffs.

Samir: Small content asks from my side: (1) change the model card compatibility row to include 'kernel fallback for long context' wording; (2) add a bullet under "Known limits" about tokenizer-induced truncation and link to tokenizer docs; (3) fix the broken tokenizer docs link in the PR (it currently 404s).

Kai: For public-facing phrasing, prefer: "Supports extended-context workloads (up to X tokens); recommended config for latency-sensitive apps: enable prefix cache and cap batch size." Short and prescriptive. Also include the runtime caveat: some quantized kernels degrade throughput at very long seqs.

Rachel: I'll fold wording into PR. Tasks list for merge: 
- Update table header 'max_length' -> 'max_context (tokens)' ✅
- Add SDK snippet (Ben) ⏳
- Insert bench numbers + one-line summary (Harper) ✅
- Fix tokenizer docs link + bullet (Samir) ⏳
- Minor wording pass to keep public copy concise (Kai/Rachel) ⏳

Ben: Working on SDK snippet branch now (ben/longseq-snippet). Will push in ~20m. Will include a short test harness snippet for node/python parity.

docs-bot: Pull request #4520 updated: ben/longseq-snippet pushed (1 new commit)

Rachel: Thanks — @Kai can you do a quick wording review tomorrow morning? If we can merge before EOD Friday ops can coordinate adding the runtime note to the model-catalog rollout. :thumbsup:

Kai: Ping me in the morning, I'll review the PR and confirm tokenizer link.

Rachel: Awesome. If anyone else sees any edge cases (very short prompts + huge context, streaming interactions), add a short note in the PR comments so we capture them before merge.

Ben: Added node snippet + short test. Marking task done on my end.

Samir: Fixed tokenizer link in PR and added the truncation bullet. Left one nit about casing.

Rachel: Great progress — keeping this open until merge but looks close. Thanks all.
